dashboard.title: Talk to an AI specialist
dashboard.intro: Describe what's on your mind and we'll suggest the right specialist, or choose one yourself. After the call you receive a written summary.

newDialog.detailsTitle: What would you like to talk about?
newDialog.detailsBody: Describe your symptoms or concerns in a few words. This helps us suggest the right specialist.
newDialog.detailsPlaceholder: For example: I've been feeling low and anxious since the birth…
newDialog.chooseBody: Based on what you shared, these specialists can help.
newDialog.suggestFailed: Couldn't suggest a specialist right now.

history.title: Consultation history
history.intro: Your past consultations and written summaries.
history.emptyBody: When you talk with a specialist, your written summaries will appear here.

report.title: Consultation summary
report.disclaimer: This summary was generated by AI. It is not a diagnosis and does not replace advice, diagnosis or treatment from a qualified health professional.

call.micError: Couldn't start the call. Please allow microphone access and try again.
call.connectError: Couldn't connect the call. Please check your microphone and try again.
call.reportFailed: The call ended, but we couldn't create your summary.
call.empty: The call ended before anything was said, so no summary was created.
call.micHint: Your browser will ask for microphone access. Speak naturally and the specialist will reply by voice.
call.disclaimer: This AI specialist offers general guidance, not a diagnosis. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.
